title: Reeks of chemical odor
text: Reeks of chemical odor. The Damp-Rid chemical smell is worse than the mildew smell, and it overpowered the lavender scent. I'm sorry I spent the money. Going to throw it out.

product_metadata.title: DampRid Lavender Vanilla Hanging Bag Moisture Absorber for Closets - Odor Eliminator - 3 pack (16oz. ea.); Traps Excess Moisture for Fresher, Cleaner Air
features: DampRid Hanging Bag Moisture Absorber attracts and traps excess moisture from the air.
By trapping excess moisture, these bags eliminate musty odors creating fresher, cleaner air.
The hanging bag design is ideal for closets, storage cabinets, the kitchen pantry, wherever stagnant, damp air is a problem.
3 Lavender Vanilla bags are included in each box, each filled with 16 ounces of moisture absorbing crystals.
To use, simply hang in the desired area. Dispose once moisture absorbing crystals have fully dissolved.
description: DampRid Hanging Bag Moisture Absorber is the moisture absorber and odor eliminator you need in your closet to prevent moisture from causing costly damage to your clothes and leather goods. Does your storage area or laundry room have a less-than-fresh smell? Place a hanging bag inside and enjoy cleaner, fresher air. Each bag contains moisture absorbing crystals that attract and trap excess moisture, eliminating the musty odors that humid, stagnant air produces. Simply hang in areas where humidity is a problem and watch how the crystals trap the moisture inside the bag. Each bag in this 3-pack lasts up to 60 days depending on temperature and humidity. Ideal for use where excess moisture and musty odors are a problem, such as closets, wardrobes, bathrooms, kitchens, laundry rooms, stored boats or RVs. Keep out of reach of children. Read & follow all label directions.
